blind.description: A broken ancient stone column resting on a square stone plinth. The base has circular molded rings supporting a fluted cylindrical shaft that has been fractured diagonally across the upper portion, exposing uneven, rough stone grain on the broken top. The stone material is weathered sandstone or limestone with subtle greenish moss and weathering stains near the bottom.
blind.from_above: A square stone plinth framing a circular fluted profile, filled with the textured, unevenly fractured surface of the sheared-off column top.
blind.extra_base_or_ground: square stone plinth base integrated into the column design
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 to 3.5 ft tall), with a base slightly wider than the figure's diameter (about 2 ft wide).
